title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: call quality feedback surveys after meetings
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap, Microsoft's tenant notice and the cited documentation. Its corrected licensing statement and Cloud Policy navigation are accurate, and it appropriately qualifies the policy's applicability to the new Android survey.

claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is introducing call quality feedback (CQF) surveys for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android.

claims.claim: Users will periodically see a call quality feedback survey after meetings end.
claims.quote: Users will periodically see a call quality feedback survey after meetings end on Teams Rooms on Android devices.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The cited feedback and Rooms management passages name Teams Rooms generally rather than Teams Rooms on Android specifically.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices may display in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts, to signed-in room accounts.

claims.claim: No new identity, permission or sign-in requirement is documented for the surveys.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "surveys" "permissions"; opened rooms-manage, rooms-plan, manage-feedback-policies-in-teams and feedback-manage; read MC1490912. No new survey identity, permission or sign-in prerequisite is stated.

claims.claim: Learn says Teams Rooms survey prompts may be shown to signed-in room accounts.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices may display in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts, to signed-in room accounts.

claims.claim: Teams admin center provides device status and software version information that administrators can check.
claims.quote: From Teams admin center, you can view the overall status of all devices in your organization ... Health Shows detailed information about the peripherals connected to your Teams Rooms device, network connectivity, sign in status to required services, and software version information.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing

claims.claim: The required app version for the new Android CQF survey has not been published.

claims.claim: Teams Administrator is a documented role for managing devices in Teams admin center.

claims.claim: Cloud Policy creation uses Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. On the Policy configurations page, select Create. On the Start with the basics page, enter a name (required) ... On the Choose the scope page ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies

claims.claim: No documented configuration API equivalent for the Cloud Policy survey setting is identified.
claims.quote: Searched: "Cloud Policy service" "API"; "Teams" "FeedbackPolicy" "ReceiveSurveysMode"; Cloud Policy Microsoft Graph automation. Opened Cloud Policy overview and Set-CsTeamsFeedbackPolicy; the latter documents a Teams feedback policy, not a Cloud Policy configuration API.

claims.claim: The policy named Allow users to receive and respond to in-product surveys from Microsoft controls whether in-product surveys appear.
claims.quote: Allow users to receive and respond to in-product surveys from Microsoft | Controls whether surveys appear within product.

claims.claim: Not Configured has the same effect as Enabled for the survey policy, rather than suppressing surveys.
claims.quote: When the following policies are set to Not Configured, it has the same effect as if you set the policies to Enabled.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends Office Apps Administrator for Cloud Policy management.
claims.quote: Office Apps Administrator (Recommended) | This role can manage Office apps cloud services, including policy and settings management

claims.claim: Feedback policy changes can take a few hours to reach client applications.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy control is user-scoped.
claims.quote: Only user-based policy settings are available. Computer-based policy settings aren't available.

claims.claim: Learn documents Cloud Policy as a way to disable Teams Rooms in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices may display in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts, to signed-in room accounts. To disable these surveys, use the Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365.
